title: The Eclipse
text: The sun goes out at noon and does not come back for an hour. The birds drop silent from the sky, the candles burn blue, and in the dark the Rift Gate glows like an open eye. The dogs will not stop howling.

outcomes.text: The House waits it out on its knees, candles burning blue, and the Gate's eye passes over you.
Nothing happens. Nothing you can name.
Something scratches at the shutters until the light returns.

options.label: Walk out under the dead sun.

outcomes.text: You see the city as the rift sees it, and understand it a little.
You see the city as the rift sees it. Some of you do not sleep for weeks.
